body: Part of e553ce, found by the feat/screen review. The runner captures right after adb returns from an input (crates/skywaved/src/screen/runner.rs, settle -> shoot), so a tap that starts a transition can be shot mid-animation or as Unchanged. Decide from the device trial (49daac): a short settle delay, a second shot, or leave it to a follow-up Capture.
title: screen: settle before the after-input shot
